messages:
maria (Marketing): quick sync: planning an OSS "Sample Packs" tutorial collection + a companion webinar. need decisions on launch post, benchmark narrative, and inbound routing.
ben (DevRel): quick q — should benchmarks show Hosted numbers or include Dedicated?
maria (Marketing): prefer Hosted in main post for accessibility; include a small Dedicated appendix for enterprise. focus narrative on dev velocity + predictable cost/latency.
ben (DevRel): ok. i'll draft a short benchmark blurb: p50/p95 latency, tokens/sec, and a tiny chart idea.
sam (Product): add one-liner about routing + graceful fallback for the demo. helps enterprise trust.
nora (Eng): i can produce a reproducible demo script that highlights prefix caching gains. will keep it copy/paste friendly (bash + python snippet).
ben (DevRel): please keep script under 150 lines so we can use it in tutorials and notebooks.
maria (Marketing): timeline proposal: draft post + tutorial set by Tue (1837720000), webinar slides by Thu, announce Wed morning. feasible?
ben (DevRel): tight but doable. i'll own benchmark narrative & one tutorial.
sam (Product): i'll own demo flow and the fallback messaging.
nora (Eng): i'll push demo script to GH and add README with expected outputs and quick run commands. include link in post.
maria (Marketing): inbound routing: ops-bot, route webinar signups -> growth queue, but tag enterprise leads for sales follow-up.
ops-bot: AUTOROUTE: proposed mapping:
- webinar signups with company_size > 100 -> sales-enterprise
- otherwise -> growth-inbound
Confirm to apply? :robot_face:
ben (DevRel): add a devrel_tag for users who opt into SDK beta (checkbox on form).
maria (Marketing): form fields: name, email, company, company_size (select), use_case (textarea), checkbox "SDK beta opt-in".
sam (Product): include hidden utm_campaign=samplepacks-launch for analytics.
nora (Eng): sample script output i'll include in README:
```
$ python run_demo.py --model redwood-small --input "Summarize"
Latency p50: 45ms
Tokens/sec: 210
Cache hit: true
```
maria (Marketing): messaging options for post intro: A) Build faster with curated model packs and reproducible benchmarks. B) Open sample packs to ship LLM features with predictable cost and latency. which to use?
ben (DevRel): vote B — predictability is our differentiator. :thumbsup: 
sam (Product): A is more dev-first, maybe A for blog intro and B for email subject-line split test.
maria (Marketing): agreed. ben, can you draft the benchmark sidebar (3 bullets + chart suggestion)?
ben (DevRel): will do. chart: tokens/sec vs model variant, table: p50/p95 across variants.
maria (Marketing): owners: marketing=maria, devrel=ben, product/demo=sam, eng artifacts=nora. ops to apply routing after we confirm fields.
ops-bot: noted. awaiting `apply` command.
maria (Marketing): i'll drop a draft by EOD and tag folks. ping here for blockers. thanks! :sparkles:
